## Type

- [ ] Translation / localization
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature

For translation changes use the dedicated template:
`?template=translation.md` — it includes the language metadata, validation and
generation checklist.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the nearest relevant build/tests.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, logs, media files or generated caches.
- [ ] For a release, `docs/releases/<tag>.md` contains English and Russian notes.
